text:
Jon: FYI — Helix Financial (sales LOE) submitted a VPC/on-prem request last night. They want an air-gapped cluster + HSM, timeline ~12 weeks. Can we triage?
Maya: @Jon can you paste the intake form here? Need expected QPS, model size, data residency notes.
Jon: copied from ticket: QPS steady 40 req/s, spikes to 120 for 10m/day, models: mix of 13B and fine-tuned 70B, data: EU-only PII, must not leave customer network.
Liam: 70B on-prem is heavy. We should clarify whether they will accept quantized fp16/int8 models. Also need node count estimate and GPU type.
Jon: said they prefer accuracy -> avoid aggressive quantization unless proven. Asking for recommended config from eng.
Priya: Security red flags: air-gap + HSM ok, but we need to run a compliance intake. SOC2 + financial regs — likely need contract addendum for audits. Also HSM integration will require KMS/PKCS11 support and on-prem key lifecycle doc.
Zoe: From SE side: they want console telemetry but only via customer-controlled metrics sink (push to their Prometheus). We need an option to disable outgoing telemetry by default.
Maya: Proposed triage outcomes: 1) feasibility + rough ETA 2) immediate blockers (legal/security/infra) 3) minimal deliverable for GA. Agree? :+1:
Liam: I'll do infra feasibility and rough cluster sizing. Estimate: for 70B at 40-120 qps w/ low-latency target, we need 6x A100-80GB or mixed A100+H100 with sharding and model parallelism. Might reduce to 4x with heavy quant and sequence-length constraints.
Priya: I'll start compliance checklist. Immediate blockers: legal SLA + audit rights, HSM integration spec, network egress policy. Also need to confirm where logs are stored and retention.
Zoe: SE can run a short eval (2-week POC) on our Dedicated infra to measure token cost/latency vs their accuracy baseline. Would help decide quant tradeoffs. Customer willing to pay for POC.
Maya: Timeline thoughts: POC 2-3 wks, infra procurement + HSM setup 4-6 wks, integration/packaging 3-4 wks, total ~10-13 wks. Blockers may extend.
Jon: Customer asks: can Redwood ship an on-prem appliance image, or do they want repo + helm charts? They asked specifically for an 'airgap bundle' they can install.
Liam: We have an existing onprem bundle but it needs work for airgap (bundle signing, offline deps, container registry mirror). Add tasks: offline package builder, install verification script, docs.
Priya: Add to checklist: threat model review, signed SBOM, HSM attestation steps, offline upgrade path, emergency rollback.
Maya: Draft minimal deliverable for MVP: - airgap install bundle + docs - KMS/HSM plugin + integration guide - config for telemetry push-only via customer endpoint (disabled by default) - security & compliance package (SBOM + threat model) - 2-week POC plan and acceptance criteria.
Zoe: Acceptance criteria example: 95th p95 latency < 350ms for 13B at 40 qps, functional parity tests pass for fine-tuned prompts, telemetry successfully pushed to customer prometheus endpoint.
Jon: Customer also wants RTO/RPO and runbook for incident handover. Add that to docs.
Maya: Ok next steps: Liam + Priya to produce blocker list + rough ETA by EOD Thu. Zoe to prep POC plan and baseline test suite. Jon to confirm procurement lead and HSM vendor model. I'll create a ticket in the product backlog and tag as customer-driven private-deploy intake.
deploy-bot: Ticket created: PROD-7893 "Helix on-prem airgap + HSM intake" assigned to Maya.
Jon: Thanks — looping in customer success to schedule kickoff once we have blocker list.
Maya: Great. If anyone hits blocking legal wording, ping me. I'll coordinate with legal + sales enablement.
Liam: I'll post cluster sizing doc and quick config matrix in the ticket when ready.
Priya: I'll attach initial compliance checklist template to PROD-7893 later today.
Zoe: Will schedule SE kickoff for next Tue.
Jon: ending thread — will update with procurement contact. :wave:
